title: MULTI-AXIS MILLING MACHINE SETTER / OPERATORS
jobDescription:
Job Summary: Responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining milling Multi-axis machines to produce precision parts and components. They ensure that the machines function efficiently, monitor the production process, and make necessary adjustments to maintain quality and productivity. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Machine Setup: Set up and prepare milling machines by selecting the appropriate cutting tools, work pieces, and machine settings. This includes loading materials and securing them in the machine. Machine Operation: Operate milling machines to perform cutting, shaping, and machining tasks on various materials such as metal, plastic, and composite materials. Quality Control: Monitor the machining process to ensure that the finished parts meet the required specifications and quality standards. Use measuring instruments like calipers, micrometers, and gauges to verify the accuracy of the work. Tool Maintenance: Regularly inspect and maintain cutting tools, including sharpening or replacing them when necessary. Ensure that the machines are well-maintained and report any issues to the maintenance department. Safety: Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines to prevent accidents and injuries while operating the machines. Properly handle and dispose of cutting fluids and waste materials. Blueprint Interpretation: Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications to understand the machining requirements and tolerances. Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and make adjustments to the machines when issues arise, such as tool wear, work piece misalignment, or other production problems. Documentation: Maintain production logs, records, and reports of completed work, including information on materials used, machine settings, and production times. Collaboration: Coordinate with team members, engineers, and supervisors to meet production goals and ensure the quality and timely delivery of components.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Diploma / Engineering in Manufacturing or equivalent combination of education and experience 5+ years’ work experience. Must be able to perform own set-ups. Able to edit programs manually, set origins and offsets. Is able to hold tolerances of +/- .0005 or better. Familiar with print reading and GD&T. Reliable and efficient with a good work ethic. Familiar with HAAS and Matsuura. Able to diagnose/troubleshoot standard manufacturing issues. Proficient with work holding methods.

title: PRODUCTION PLANNING CONTROLLER / SHIFT SUPERVISOR
jobDescription:
Job Overview: As a Shift Supervisor / PPC in our aerospace manufacturing facility, you will be responsible for coordinating and optimizing production schedules to meet delivery timelines and quality standards. This role involves collaborating with various departments to ensure seamless workflow, efficient resource allocation, and timely completion of manufacturing projects. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Production Scheduling: Develop and maintain production schedules based on customer orders, project timelines, and resource availability. Adapt to our current ERP system.
2. Capacity Planning: Monitor production capacity and allocate resources effectively to meet production demands.
3. Collaboration: Work closely with production teams, supply chain management, and engineering departments to gather information on production requirements and constraints.
4. Inventory Management: Oversee inventory levels to prevent shortages and excess stock, ensuring optimal use of resources.
5. Timeline Adherence: Ensure adherence to project timelines and delivery schedules, proactively identifying and addressing potential delays.
6. Data Analysis: Analyze historical production data and performance metrics to identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency.
7. Communication: Regularly communicate production schedules, changes, any updates regarding push outs or pull-ins, foster a collaborative work environment.
8. Problem Solving: Address and resolve scheduling conflicts, bottlenecks, and resource constraints in a timely manner.
9. Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation related to production schedules, resource allocations, and workflow processes.
10. Continuous Improvement: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance production planning and scheduling processes.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field or equivalent to 7+ years of experience. • Proven experience in production scheduling, preferably in aerospace manufacturing. • Targets achievement in Hourly, Daily, weekly against production Plan • Planning and ensuring the Raw materials, tools, fixtures in time before change over. • Monitoring and ensure the stage wise process and quantity • Ensure the shift wise OEE • Ensure and control the rejection levels in each stage • Maintain shop floor 5s at all time • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, resource allocation, and capacity planning. • Proficiency in using scheduling software and ERP systems. • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. • Effective communication and interpersonal skills. • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
